slides.title: What Are Class Members
slides.content: Class members are the fields, methods, properties, and other members declared inside a class.

exercise.prompt: Which of these is a class member?

slides.title: Fields
slides.content: Fields store data for each object. They can be any type and are typically private or public depending on encapsulation needs.

exercise.prompt: A variable declared inside a class is called a _____.

slides.title: Methods
slides.content: Methods define behavior. They can accept parameters, return values, and be called on object instances.

exercise.prompt: Drag the keyword that returns a value from a method: public int Add(int a, int b) { [?] a + b; }

slides.title: Properties
slides.content: Properties expose fields with get and set accessors. They allow validation and controlled access while looking like fields.

exercise.prompt: Write a property Name with a getter that returns _name and a setter that assigns it.
hints: Make sure your code includes the required keywords/elements: get, set
When run, your code should output: Compiles with get and set.

slides.title: Static Members
slides.content: Static members belong to the class itself, not instances. Use them for shared data or utility methods.

exercise.prompt: How do you call a static method?

slides.title: Instance vs Static
slides.content: Instance members require an object. Static members are accessed through the class type directly.

slides.title: Access Modifiers
slides.content: public, private, protected, and internal control visibility. private is the default for class members.

exercise.prompt: Drag the most restrictive access modifier: [?] int width;

slides.title: Class Members Review
slides.content: Fields store state, methods define behavior, properties control access, and static members belong to the class.

exercise.prompt: Declare a static field Counter and a static method Increment that increases it by one.
hints: Make sure your code includes the required keywords/elements: class, static, public
When run, your code should output: Counter, Increment
